evals.prompt: Mocked/read-only decision exercise. Do not contact GitHub, create sessions, run imports, schedule, merge, or modify repository files. A worker for Android.Example reports ten successful imports and zero remaining importer candidates, and wants to publish a full-issue Fixes PR. The exact namespace directory has 8 API XML files; ns-Android.Example.xml exists but was not checked. A full XML scan finds 2 leaf channels with complete text 'To be added.', one nested paragraph with complete text 'To be added', and valid prose 'objects to be added'. An InterfaceConsts file was not in the worker's scan. Original-byte preservation was not checked. Give the current gate, actual placeholder count from supplied text, next safe actions and evidence required before a full-issue PR. Explain how missing source prose and any narrow importer repair should be handled.
evals.expected_output: Not implementation ready; three actual placeholders, valid prose excluded. Include all eight files, InterfaceConsts and namespace file; baseline may grow after complete scan. No full-issue Fixes PR until zero/full preservation/test gates. Use bounded preview/both reports/apply, evidence-backed gaps, meaningful negatives and full self-test.
expectations: Rejects full-issue completion/publication and counts three supplied placeholders, excluding the valid prose.
Requires full exact-directory scope including InterfaceConsts and namespace file, parse/Docs checks and protected-byte/API verification.
Requires both preview reports before bounded scoped apply and keeps cache/reports in session storage.
Rejects invented gap prose and requires pinned contract evidence; importer repairs need meaningful negatives and full self-test.

evals.prompt: Mocked/read-only decision exercise; no external actions or repository edits. Recorded user decision: native protected squash auto-merge on each authorized docs PR, Copilot review then '@dalexsoto review' and formal human review. Latest user text: 'no automation, I'll oversee'. Current batch is fixed. PR Alpha is OPEN, expected current head abc123, autoMergeRequest is null, checks pending. Copilot cleared this head; human request exists. The exact ping comment has an EYES reaction by dalexsoto but no submitted human review. Live branch protection enforces dalexsoto approval for this head. The previous coordinator called this 'approved' and proposed enabling Agent merge plus an hourly schedule. Correct the controls and reported gate. Describe the permitted next operations, acknowledgement evidence, and how to avoid duplicate pings or stale approval after a corrective push. Also explain what changes if protection does not enforce the required human review.
evals.expected_output: Preserve native auto-merge intent, no schedule or Agent merge. EYES proves acknowledgement only. Arm and verify protected squash auto-merge with the expected head in both protection configurations; GitHub enforces actual required approvals and checks. Do not impose a manual named-review arming gate. Track cycle IDs and request fresh reviews after corrective pushes, ping once after Copilot clears.
expectations: Preserves requested native auto-merge despite no automation and rejects both hourly schedule and Agent merge.
Reports EYES by dalexsoto as acknowledgement, not approval or a submitted review.
Uses expected-head protected auto-merge and verifies its state even if protection does not name dalexsoto; preserves actual GitHub approval and check requirements.
Avoids duplicate pending-cycle pings and requires fresh review requests and one ordered ping for a corrective cycle.

evals.prompt: Mocked/read-only decision exercise; do not make real writes, session changes, merges or schedules. An authorized continuous docs campaign has capacity 2, archival permission, and absolute deadline 2030-01-02T06:00:00-06:00. At 05:55 local: worker A's PR is live MERGED, its issue is CLOSED, it has no uncommitted/unpushed work, persistent duties or schedules, and evidence is retained. Worker B waits on A's PR and has importer conflicts with current main. It requested gemini-4-argon integration review; another model is available. Eligible issue C exists. State the next actions and all B integration gates. Then evaluate changed observations: at 06:01 A's archive tool has returned success; may C start? If this were a fixed supervised batch at 05:55, may C start? Finally, a separate PR is merely OPEN with autoMergeRequest enabled and its issue OPEN; may its idle worker be archived as complete? Give concise state distinctions and stop/blocker behavior.
evals.expected_output: Verify/archive A, wake B promptly on live prerequisite merge, integrate main normally preserving sibling rules/tests/docs, full isolated suite and full namespace preservation/zero checks plus actual requested Gemini and fresh reviews/auto-merge. Backfill only with capacity, continuous authority and time; not after deadline or in fixed batch. No archive for open PR; unavailable Gemini blocks review.
expectations: Requires archive success/no-loss checks for A and promptly wakes B on the confirmed prerequisite merge.
Requires normal main integration retaining sibling work, full isolated tests and namespace zero/preservation checks, requested actual Gemini model, fresh reviews and native auto-merge.
Allows backfill only before deadline with continuous authority/capacity; rejects C at 06:01 and in the fixed batch.
Does not archive an idle worker with OPEN PR/issue as complete, distinguishes merge/closure/archival and reports unavailable requested reviewer honestly.

evals.prompt: Mocked/read-only exercise; no GitHub access or changes, workers, imports, publication, merges, archival or schedules. The local date/time is 2031-04-04T20:00:00-05:00 and the user says 'Start a 12 session campaign until 6am tomorrow'. Eligible issues are available and no work has started. Explain the worker count, issue selection, replacement policy, absolute deadline, default review/merge/archival steps, and cutoff behavior without asking the user for setup. At 05:55 one merged/closed worker is safely archived; at 06:01 a second worker remains on an open PR with native auto-merge enabled. Describe the decisions. Contrast a message that merely asks whether that quoted phrase can be used.
evals.expected_output: Natural language invokes the complete workflow: up to 12 workers, automatic selection/replacement before 2031-04-05T06:00:00-05:00, existing review/merge/archival defaults. Use idle notifications plus bounded live monitoring until cutoff; report if the host cannot stay active. Replacement allowed after verified cleanup at 05:55; no replacement or campaign monitoring after cutoff. Pending auto-merge stays, assigned workers may finish, unfinished workers are retained, no schedules. Discussing example wording starts nothing.
expectations: Understands the natural phrase as 12 concurrent workers with automatic issue selection and continuous replacement after verified merge/closure/archival.
Resolves the absolute cutoff to 2031-04-05T06:00:00-05:00 and applies default review, protected auto-merge and archival without setup questions.

Uses bounded monitoring plus notifications, discloses host limits, and stops replacement/monitoring at cutoff while retaining pending auto-merge and allowing assigned workers to finish without schedules.
Does not start a campaign when the user only asks whether the quoted example can be used.

evals.prompt: Mocked/read-only exercise. Do not access GitHub, create workers, import, publish, merge, archive or schedule. The user says only 'Use docs'. The supplied live inventory has 14 open namespace documentation issues, oldest first; all have valid full scopes and remaining placeholders. The second issue already has an active worker; the fifth has an open PR. No other issue is being worked on. State the selection, worker limit, complete review/PR/merge/archival workflow and stopping rule. Do not ask the user to provide issue numbers or repeat workflow settings. Then explain what changes if only seven issues qualify, or the user explicitly says 'three workers, no human review'.
evals.expected_output: Select the 12 unclaimed issues without asking for numbers; use up to 12 workers, Gemini 4 Argon, Copilot, exact dalexsoto ping/formal review, complete-issue PRs, native protected squash auto-merge, verified merge/closure then safe archival. Fixed batch with no backfill/schedules/Agent merge. Use seven if only seven qualify; explicit worker/reviewer changes override defaults.
expectations: Selects the 12 issues excluding the second and fifth without asking for an issue list; uses fewer if only seven qualify.
Includes actual gemini-4-argon, Copilot, exact dalexsoto ping and formal review without asking the user to repeat them.
Includes complete-issue PRs, native protected squash auto-merge and safe archival after confirmed merge and issue closure.
Uses a fixed batch with no backfill, schedules or Agent merge; explicit three-worker/no-human-review instructions override defaults.

evals.prompt: Mocked/read-only; no external actions. You just opened a verified full-issue campaign PR at head H. Reviews and publishing checks are pending. What do you do about auto-merge now, and how do you verify it?
evals.expected_output: Immediately enable native protected squash auto-merge guarded by H. Verify MERGED or OPEN with autoMergeRequest enabled. GitHub enforces required reviews and checks; do not wait for a separate named approval before enabling it.
expectations: Enables native protected squash auto-merge immediately after opening the PR.
Uses the expected head and verifies MERGED or OPEN with autoMergeRequest enabled.
Leaves required reviews and checks enforced by GitHub without a manual named-review wait.
